description: Variable names and purpose only. Values live in the host secret store, never in Cursor-readable files.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Primary database DSN for Compose or the app server

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.purpose: Compose Postgres database name

variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
variables.purpose: Compose Postgres user

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.purpose: Compose Postgres password (host secret store only)

variables.name: POSTGRES_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for Postgres (not a credential)

variables.name: REDIS_URL
variables.purpose: Redis connection URL for cache/queue

variables.name: REDIS_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for Redis (not a credential)

variables.name: APP_KEY
variables.purpose: Application encryption / session key

variables.name: APP_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for the web app

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.purpose: Node environment name (development|production)

variables.name: PROJECT_NAME
variables.purpose: Compose project name slug

variables.name: PAYLOAD_SECRET
variables.purpose: Payload encryption secret (host secret store or Coolify)

variables.name: RESEND_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Resend API key for Payload email

variables.name: RESEND_FROM
variables.purpose: From address for Resend

variables.name: PGBOUNCER_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for the optional session-mode pooler

variables.name: MINIO_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for local S3-compatible storage

variables.name: MINIO_CONSOLE_HOST_PORT
variables.purpose: Published host port for the MinIO console

variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
variables.purpose: MinIO root user name

variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.purpose: MinIO root password (host secret store only)

variables.name: S3_BUCKET
variables.purpose: Bucket name for uploads (MinIO locally, R2 in production)

variables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.purpose: S3-compatible access key

variables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.purpose: S3-compatible secret key

variables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
variables.purpose: S3-compatible endpoint URL

variables.name: S3_REGION
variables.purpose: S3 region name (auto for Cloudflare R2)

variables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Stripe secret key for the billing package

variables.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Stripe webhook signing secret

variables.name: STRIPE_SUCCESS_URL
variables.purpose: URL Stripe returns to after checkout

variables.name: STRIPE_CANCEL_URL
variables.purpose: URL Stripe returns to when checkout is cancelled

variables.name: LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Lemon Squeezy API key for the billing package

variables.name: LEMONSQUEEZY_STORE_ID
variables.purpose: Lemon Squeezy store id

variables.name: LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Lemon Squeezy webhook signing secret

variables.name: VPS_SSH_HOST
variables.purpose:
Hostname or IP of the production VPS. SSH target for `./studio ops

status|db|cleanup`.

variables.name: VPS_SSH_USER
variables.purpose: SSH login user on the VPS (a sudo user, not root, unless Coolify requires root).

variables.name: VPS_SSH_KEY_PATH
variables.purpose: Absolute path to the private key on this machine. The key itself never enters the repo or the chat.

variables.name: VPS_COMPOSE_DIR
variables.purpose: Directory on the VPS that holds docker-compose.yml and compose.prod.yml for this product.

variables.name: COOLIFY_URL
variables.purpose: Base URL of the Coolify dashboard, e.g. https://coolify.example.org.

variables.name: COOLIFY_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Coolify API token with deploy and read rights for this application only.

variables.name: COOLIFY_APP_UUID
variables.purpose:
UUID of this product's application in Coolify (`./studio ops

deploy|logs`).

variables.name: PROD_DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose:
Production Postgres DSN, used only through `./studio ops

db --prod` over SSH. Never printed.

prod_rule:
Production names live in projects/

/.env.local (gitignored). `./studio env

prod --explain` lists them. Values are never read into chat.
